name: Alcázar del Rey (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alcázar del Rey (a castle on blue and a lion and crescent on red).
history: Municipal flag of Alcázar del Rey; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alcázar del Rey arms — castle, lion and crescent
